[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T19:02:09Z, by staff] Fox Corporation Receives Shareholder and Foreign Regulatory Approvals for Roku Acquisition
Fox Corporation announced that it has secured all necessary shareholder and foreign regulatory approvals for its planned $22 billion acquisition of Roku, Inc.
During its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings announcement on November 2, 2026, Fox Corporation confirmed that it has received all required shareholder and foreign regulatory clearances for its proposed $22 billion acquisition of Roku, Inc. The company is currently working with the U.S. Department of Justice to obtain final antitrust clearance, with the deal expected to close by the first half of 2027. While the transaction has faced some scrutiny from state attorneys general, the progress in securing foreign and shareholder approvals has narrowed the deal spread. Roku remains the target of this acquisition, which is a significant strategic development for the streaming platform.
